ORDINANCE



 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-2,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District; and B3-2, Community Shopping District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-C in the area bound by:

        South Stony Island Avenue; a line 100 feet north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; the
        alley next east of and parallel to South Stony Island Avenue; a line 150 feet north of and
        parallel to East 71 st Street; South Cornell Avenue; a line 300 feet north of and parallel to
        East 71 st Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Cornell Avenue; a line 178
        feet north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South East End Avenue; a line 100 feet
        north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South East
        End Avenue; a line 150 feet north of and parallel to East 71 s t Street; South Crager
        Avenue; a line 200 feet north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Constance
        Avenue; and East 71 st Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




Common Address:
1600-1820 E. 71 st Street
